sources.entry: MenubarCC - Menu bar crab that shows your Claude Code sessions at a glance: walking while Claude works, bouncing when it needs you. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ksterx/MenubarCC) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: MenubarCC is a macOS menu bar app that shows the status of your Claude Code sessions through an animated crab icon (Clawd), with sound alerts and stuck-session detection.
summary.what_it_does: Clawd, the menu bar icon, walks while a Claude Code session is busy, bounces when a session is waiting for your reply, pulses when a session appears stuck, and sits still when idle. Clicking the icon opens a menu listing every session grouped into Stuck, Active, Waiting, and Idle, with each project folder and how long it has been in that state. A small hook bridge (menubarcc_hook.py) is installed into Claude Code's settings.json to maintain a waiting flag and play sounds on Stop, Notification, and PermissionRequest events. Sounds can be toggled per event or muted globally, and custom sound files can be chosen. Stuck detection can be set to 5 to 60 minutes or turned off, and the app can launch at login and update itself in-app. The app reads local session files under ~/.claude/ and makes a single network call, the update check against GitHub.
use_cases: Monitor several Claude Code sessions at once from the menu bar
Get alerted when Claude Code needs a reply or permission
Detect Claude Code sessions that have stalled
Hear a sound when Claude Code finishes a response
Keep an eye on which project folders are busy or idle
how_to_run: Or download MenubarCC-x.y.z.dmg from the Releases page and drag MenubarCC into Applications
stack: Claude Code settings.json and session status files
notable: Menu bar only: no window and no Dock icon
Hook bridge installs into Claude Code settings with a timestamped backup and removes only its own entries
Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple
Clawd's animation reflects the most urgent session state (Waiting > Stuck > Active > Idle)
In-app update check, download, and install
caveats: Requires Claude Code to be installed; Launch at Login requires running from /Applications
keywords: tell me when claude needs input
